mapper.select: SELECT ma.profile_img, ma.ranking, f.member_id, ch.title AS chal_title, f.code, f.title, f.text, fh.feed_code AS fh_code, fh.tag_name, f.hitcount, f.status, f.created_at, i.code AS icode, i.target_code, CONCAT('/images/', i.type, '/', i.path, '/', i.filename) AS image_url, ( SELECT count(feed_code) FROM comments c WHERE c.feed_code = f.code ) AS count_comment, ( SELECT count(feed_code) FROM feed_like fl WHERE fl.feed_code = f.code ) AS count_like FROM feed f LEFT JOIN images i ON f.code = i.target_code AND i.type = 'feed' JOIN challenge ch ON f.chal_code = ch.code JOIN member_account ma ON f.member_id = ma.id LEFT JOIN feed_hashtag fh ON f.code = fh.feed_code WHERE f.status = 'active' ORDER BY f.created_at DESC
